sections.title: Accepted SaveAs Observation
sections.text: A post-step metadata getter error must not erase a SaveAs receipt that the native call already returned as accepted. composeNew preserves that receipt and observes the same retained document without repeating SaveAs: creation identity, intended destination/version, preserved source and pre-save target content must match before continuation. Publication/readback can remain pending within the existing budget. This is not automatic success for a SaveAs exception or an unknown submission. Diagnostic errorSite records the actual Python/SDK getter frames. Explicit save reconciliation verifies every retained staged instance, including repeated definitions, and their planned poses; it never chooses a single candidate merely by file ID. Drift or missing proof blocks rather than weakening identity.

sections.title: Copy Correlation Metadata
sections.text: New copy intents persist a private nonce before Component.saveCopyAs submission and pass it directly in the generated description argument. The marker is retained in the ORIGINAL COPY VERSION; later authorized Document.save descriptions belong to their later versions. Finalize verifies the exact original copy-version receipt, not a later version's save comment, and never rewrites DataFile.description. This is not preservation of source cloud descriptions. Caller description fields are unsupported and rejected by strict manifest/item/destination validation before submission. Existing reused files are not marked; old unknown copies are not retrofitted. Copy completion uses either the original finished DataFileFuture or a pre-registered event whose captured file ID uniquely matches the submitted nonce, project, folder and version, followed by fresh exact-ID DataFile readback and isComplete:true. No filename lookup establishes identity. The handler snapshots status primitives during notify and retains neither DataEventArgs nor Status wrappers. DataEventArgs properties are not populated for every event: getter errors remain diagnostics, not success/failure or an additional mandatory completion gate. The qualified saveCopyAs host emitted dataFileComplete with complete exact-ID readback while args.status raised inside notify; the raw Processing future was preserved separately. Explicit error status, contradictory future failure, ambiguous IDs or version drift block completion. Geometry/history verification is separate. The bounded initiating event-pump window does not promise to repair a stalled future.

sections.title: Grouped History And Typed Inputs
sections.text: A closed same-parent extraction group uses instancePolicy:selected and explicit sibling membership; implicit allInstances expansion of a logical group is unsupported, never inferred from only its first member definition. It is assembled only inside its isolated parent copy; original occurrences are never reparented. Supported Combine input owners are captured there with exact timeline-marker restoration. The qualified original-input adapter is deliberately narrow: direct sibling components, unambiguous single-body inputs, distinct captured component attributes, unchanged feature type/name/index/operation/keep-tool setting, and matching body attributes/material. It rebinds the COPIED original Combine targetBody/toolBodies through native setters; it never rebuilds, flattens, suppresses or deletes feature history. This is phase-owned copy preparation/publication, not a public repair API. Unmapped or unsupported contexts stop; equal cached BRep cannot authorize unhealthy history for installation. Declare source driver probes to verify live feature response and restoration. moveToComponent and saveCopyAs can drop occurrence attributes: native child attributes are restored in the owned copy, and root-context proxy attributes are restored separately during assembly stage. Native child health, history, metadata and CSG are checked before promotion. Grouped child binding/restoration publications advance the effective pinned version; original copy-version correlation remains available.

sections.title: Repeated Contexts And Final Save
sections.text: Nested insertion derives parent-local placement from the source root-context matrix. For the qualified addByInsert behavior, the implementation converts that local matrix to a root-space insertion delta and checks every authorized resulting world pose; it never silently ungrounds an occurrence. Shared-parent allInstances retirement/replacement acts once per shared native occurrence and accounts for all corresponding root-qualified contexts; unrelated instances remain protected. replaceExternal still uses native replaceAll:false, never local deletion. A SaveAs exception is not success: inspect can reconcile a qualified saved target only through its retained native document and exact saved/cloud-complete readback, unchanged source and staged geometry checks, without discovering a target by filename. A surviving native document can acquire a new creationId during SaveAs. Subsequent continuation must match the reconciled target fingerprint; an ordinary created-target save is observed against that target, not against composeNew's preserved source. Unknown effects are never replayed.

sections.title: Typed Boundary Readback
sections.text: Supported rigid and revolute boundaries preserve explicit endpoint frames, angle/offset expressions, flip, attributes, grounding and stored enabled/disabled limits. Revolute nominal position is set after the limits; any pending position snapshot is captured before recompute/save, then nominal position and protected poses are read back. This does not authorize arbitrary ungrounding or solver rollback. Original boundary names are restored only after mapped originals are absent and name collisions are excluded. Unsupported DOF/forms reject before detach.

sections.title: Modes And Phases
sections.text: Four explicit modes with no strategy fallback: copyAndReplace (saveCopyAs -> async cloud complete -> verify), replaceFromExisting (exact dataFileId/version, in-place, no saveCopyAs), composeNew (new lightweight parametric document from native refs plus declared root datums/parameter map, source unchanged), replaceExternal (replaces an already-external reference via Occurrence.replace only, never internally). Phases are run (default) or one of copy|verify|stage|retire|finalize|inspect; verify requires verificationScope:sources|assembly. run order is copy -> verify(sources) -> stage -> verify(assembly) -> retire -> finalize; retire is notApplicable for composeNew/replaceExternal. Each phase runs only its own work: inherent save/publication is declared in the phase that owns it, never a hidden other phase. inspect strictly performs no open/activate/save/driver/publish/delete/finalize and zero lifecycle effects.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Envelope: {schemaVersion:1, operation:component.externalize, operationId, requestHash, invocationStatus:complete|partial|blocked|unknown|failed, migrationComplete:boolean, budgetExceeded:boolean, actualElapsedMs, byItem:{itemId:{itemId, uploadStatus:notStarted|pending|complete|failed|unknown, rawUploadState, phaseResults:{copy, verify:{sources,assembly}, stage, retire, finalize}}}, lifecycleEffects, pending, continuation, error?}. Each phase result has {status:notStarted|pending|complete|notApplicable|failed|blocked|unknown, receipt?}. invocationStatus:complete means the whole requested scope finished; migrationComplete additionally requires the whole original manifest plus global binding/cloud-save checks. Native queued/accepted submission normalizes to uploadStatus:pending. uploadStatus:complete confirms upload completion only; grouped copy preparation/publication can still be pending, and it never implies staged/verified/migration success. continuation carries reportPath, remainingItemIds/remainingCheckIds, nextPhase, canResume and reason (complete|budgetExhausted|unknownExecution|pendingPublication). budgetExceeded is a separate boolean from continuation.reason.

sections.title: Identity, Reuse And Guards
sections.text: source pins a saved recovery baseline {projectId,fileId,creationId,version} with optional context:topLevel. Reused items pin exact dataFileId/projectId/version (optional creationId/context:topLevel) in the destination project; filename collisions never authorize overwrite or name-only reuse; unpinned existing files and ambiguous loaded contexts block. New copies require a native selection or extraction group and a same-project destination. Guards include project equality, disjoint allInstances scope, cycle detection (source graph must be complete and in-project), typed rigid/revolute boundaries (unsupported DOF/forms reject before detach), and composeNew sets/checks ParametricDesignType. confirmReplace:true is required for replaceExternal; confirmRetire:true only for local retire in copyAndReplace/replaceFromExisting; save:true is required for run/finalize and driver probes. Old cloud files are never deleted; no restart, cache purge, auto-repair or arbitrary rollback.

sections.title: Bounded Continuation And No-replay
sections.text: maxItems (considered units across the invocation), maxChecks (completed verification checks) and timeBudgetMs bound FORWARD work only; they never cancel a running native call or subdivide an indivisible call. A settled budget stop is partial with continuation.reason budgetExhausted and is resumable via resume:true on the SAME immutable manifest; unknown native effects persist as unknown with reason unknownExecution (canResume:false, never replayed); a pending async publication stops as pendingPublication. resume continues only known-safe checkpoints and never repeats unknown work; manifest drift rejects a new operation/replay. A pending save/upload/CSG is never resumed as mutation or retried.

sections.title: Extracted-child Native Binding
sections.text: parameterBindings optionally declares targetItemId to create/reuse a native Derive in that exact owned extracted child rather than the assembly. The child must be a clean saved editor; save:true authorizes its stage publication in the same lineage, and insertion uses the confirmed resulting version. Copying a parameter-dependent component can preserve a healthy scalar snapshot, not a live link: a copied alias may still read driver_Ref while driver_Ref itself is now a USER snapshot. existingExpression must be the actual alias expression, not its evaluated 10 mm value. Inspect the copied parameters after bounded copy/source verification when the expression is not known. Existing-expression/unit/value preconditions are checked before creating a Derive. Runtime DerivedParameter names can gain suffixes such as driver_Ref1; multi-favorite sources require explicit nativeDerivedParameter mapping, never guessed suffixes. A newly tagged declaredParameterReference helper is excluded from physical part inventory, not from health/binding verification. This is initial declared binding, not an API for repairing dirty/failed files or reselecting an existing Derive.

sections.title: Driver Probes And Source Restoration
sections.text: probes are declared continuous scalar source parameters with exact pins, a numeric range and checks, plus a .10 references.refresh request; they require save authorization. For an installed extracted body, use measurement.data.ref:{itemId,bodyIndex,instanceIndex?}; indexes are zero-based and bodyIndex selects a direct body of the installed child. Its exact file/version and occurrence context are checked; measuring the original local component is not extracted-child propagation proof. The consumer baseline is saved, captured and closed BEFORE any preliminary producer perturbation or publication. A confirmed producer publication is closed before cold consumer refresh. Own bound child editors are also closed after the parent and before producer restoration. Cloud completion can precede the editor version readback; observe the same save rather than submit another save or close a transient old pin. refresh.nativeFallback defaults to never; qualifiedOnce requires request-bound driverUiLeases and restoreUiLeases maps keyed by exact consumer fileId (existing .11 leases bound to deterministic apply requestId and target, never minted here). .10 refreshes descendant children before the parent; probes track their confirmed publication versions. Restoration requires nominal expressions/values, child geometry/history and separate cloud/cold consumer proof. Unknown publication never triggers compensation until reconciled; a recovered failed fixture is not a clean end-to-end pass. Native SDK behavior remains qualified only by owned scratch tests on the tested Fusion build, not offline mocks.

examples.label: Inspect an existing composeNew operation
examples.requires: Replace every PROJECT/SOURCE/CREATION/CHILD/FOLDER placeholder with a saved identity discovered in the allowed project; the immutable manifest must already exist. Native read-only inspection still requires the sole Fusion lease; an unavailable editor is not opened.
examples.output: Returns the durable per-item phaseResults, uploadStatus/rawUploadState, lifecycleEffects and continuation; inspect never opens/activates/saves/replays.

verified: four explicit modes and single-phase ownership
immutable manifest identity and no-replay continuation
qualifiedOnce driver/restore UI leases and source restoration

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result on success is {status:complete, occurrences:[reference], paths:[string], fileId, version, worldPoses:[matrix], isReferencedComponent:true, lifecycleEffects, reconciledAfterException:boolean}. A native insertion that raised and could not be uniquely reconciled returns {status:unknown, partial, noReplay:true, reason, observedCandidates, lifecycleEffects}. A post-insert pin/identity failure returns {status:failed, retainedOccurrence:reference, partial:true, reason, noReplay:true, lifecycleEffects}; the wrong-version inserted occurrence is retained for inspection and is never auto-deleted or replayed. Envelope created includes the inserted occurrence references.

sections.title: Guards
sections.text: source is the exact {dataFileId,version} of an accessible, cloud-complete native DataFile in the destination project; confirm:true is required. destination is root (default) or a unique local root-context occurrence; placement/placementSpace:root|parent (required for nonroot placement, forbidden without placement) and sharedParentPolicy:reject|allInstances apply as for occurrence.add. The insert uses addByInsert and then re-pins the exact version. Cycles, inaccessible source graphs with out-of-project edges, and source-project mismatch block before mutation. This is standalone linked insertion: it deletes nothing and is not a local occurrence.add or neutral import alias. Native insertion semantics require a leased owned-scratch qualification; offline doubles alone do not certify Fusion.

examples.label: Insert an exact pinned native file
examples.requires: Replace FILE_ID with an exact saved DataFile ID and version in the destination project; the file must be cloud-complete and cycle-free relative to the target document.
examples.output: result.occurrences[0] is the linked occurrence; result.fileId/version confirm the exact pinned source.

verified: exact pinned source and cloud-complete guard
post-submit reconciliation without replay or auto-delete
